raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-15 rollout, the v2 collector writes txn_ts in UTC while legacy writes America/Chicago local time, and silver casts both as-is. v2 transactions from the Chicago evening therefore land at 00:00-06:00 on the next day, which explains the out-of-hours alerts and the 31-row 2026-01-19 bucket. The fix converts v2 timestamps to Chicago local time; all data is in January, so CST is a fixed UTC-6.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
